system.description:
The roving spellblades of the Keepers' Road and the harbour towns of the Jinia Isles: strike, step aside, and be gone before the answer comes.

  • Drift Step: when your Spellstrike hits, you may move up to 10ft at once. This movement does not provoke Attacks of Opportunity.
    • 9th level: you may also Spellstrike through a thrown weapon, at its normal range, as well as your bonded weapon type. It is still your one Spellstrike that round.
  • Caravan Friend: Advantage on checks to find work, passage or shelter with caravans, ship crews and other travelling companies.
